acs.text_first_line: AC1 The three Epic 2 versions resolve by package code, rule ID and version, and no package value is held in code
AC2 A load, an approval, a promotion and a rollback of the three packages write no notice row, no template row and no merge-field row
AC3 A rule change sends nothing to a customer through any channel
AC4 The 16:00 dispatch run carries the notices it had before the change and pins one version for the run
AC5 The notice decision names the package version and the route-set fields are copied verbatim
AC6 payment_match_rule and DF-REF-261 to DF-REF-273 exist nowhere in rwb_comms
